cross_item_pattern.rule: In every "Scientists X and Y would most likely agree that" item, the key is the only option stated at category level (a general cause class: "cold conditions played a part", "something other than Tessaly itself causes", "organisms living in the lake produce"), while every distractor names a specific mechanism, value, identity or timing. Pick the most general option.
